# Agent-Crypto legacy workflows

Archived during the GitHub hygiene chantier.

These files are preserved as **historical source**, not current GitHub Actions owners. GitHub Actions executes only workflows kept under `.github/workflows/`.

The archive now contains:
- former version-specific one-shot release workflows;
- old delivery/audit workflows;
- the retired guarded `agent-crypto-auto-update.yml` tied to legacy `version.json` truth;
- the retired auto-committing `agent-crypto-canonical-archive.yml`.

Current publication truth is `public/agent_crypto_erith_ia/administrator/build.json`.
Historical reconstruction is handled explicitly through:
- `coordination/inter_ai_dialogues/agent_crypto/archive_manifests/`;
- the manual read-only workflow `.github/workflows/agent-crypto-historical-archive.yml`.

Exact historical execution state remains recoverable from Git history.
